title: Width is read via stdout?.columns (Node TTY API), consistent with the pre-exist…
description:
Width is read via stdout?.columns (Node TTY API), consistent with the pre-existing line 189 usage. Ink 7 also exposes a useWindowSize() hook that returns { columns, rows }; a future refactor could unify width reads on it. Non-blocking and out of scope for this surgical cosmetic fix.

Source: cam/issue-306
Review round: 1

suggestion-fingerprint: 04bfca0b594e

spec.scope: Unify the Dashboard width reads (currently via stdout?.columns, the Node TTY API, at the CAM-306 width-change site and the pre-existing line-189 usage) onto Ink 7's useWindowSize() hook which returns { columns, rows }. Preserve the existing width-change frame-clear behavior and render output.
acceptanceCriteria: Dashboard width is read via Ink 7's useWindowSize() hook instead of raw stdout?.columns at both the CAM-306 width-change site and the pre-existing usage.
The width-change frame-clear behavior (CAM-306) and overall render output are unchanged; existing dashboard tests pass.
gotchas: This is an idiomatic-consistency refactor of working code; keep the resize/clear semantics identical to CAM-306.
